candidates.change_summary: Make owner() return msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Make owner() always return the zero address.
Remove the _checkOwner() call from the onlyOwner modifier so any caller can invoke transferOwnership and change the owner.
Delete the require(newOwner != address(0)) statement so ownership can be transferred to the zero address, changing the observable owner state after the call.
Delete the _transferOwnership(newOwner) call so the owner state variable is never updated when transferOwnership is invoked.
Return the negation of the _paused flag instead of its value.
Always return true regardless of the _paused flag.
Always return false regardless of the _paused flag.
